entities.name: Karolína Muchová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karolína Muchová is a Czech professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 8, achieved in September 2023, and a doubles ranking of No. 156, reached in January 2026. She is the current No. 1 Czech WTA singles player.
